MOZ.note: ISO member page states nothing on a national data policy.

facts.fact: The ISO member page lists INNOQ as a correspondent member of ISO, with 5 technical committees as participating member and 9 as observing member.
facts.system: Instituto Nacional de Normalização e Qualidade (INNOQ)

facts.fact: The ISO member page says INNOQ was established on 24 March 1993 by Law Decree 02/93 of the Council of Ministers as the central body coordinating standardization and quality at national level.
facts.system: Instituto Nacional de Normalização e Qualidade (INNOQ)
